notes.title: Virtual Desktop passthrough supported
notes.content:
Hi, have you tried the Quest 3 MR passthrough? [url=https://www.vrdesktop.net/]Virtual Desktop[/url] the popular connection software between PC and VR HMD recently added VR Patthrought feature. It replaces a specific color from HMD output to passthrough video.

Now, we added custom color vignette to use this feature. You can see peripheral passthrough vision instead of black vignette. This video is the test with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1465070/Legendary_Tales/]Legendary Tales[/url]. This also works on Quest 1, 2 or PICO 4 with Virtual Desktop.

[previewyoutube=3Jalkcc7mVA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]How to use?[/h2]

1. Connect HMD to PC with Virtual Desktop.
2. In STREAMING menu of VD, check VR Passthrough "Enabled".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672198/b6bb9f0e9a4e527b0f066698435b8bb29c39121f.jpg[/img]

3. Click "configure..." button, then select a passthrough key color. (e.g. R=0, G=255, B=0)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672198/66a0d246dccc7ca20dc22b23c81b0105428de73f.jpg[/img]

4. Toggle to SteamVR in VD and launch OVR Locomotion Effect.
5. Select Circle or Rect effect.
6. Set custom color to the color you set in VD config. Max value represents as 1. (e.g. R=0, G=1, B=0)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672198/b4d44948b1cd6b5e9335b5e1a1cac5ead4ff0da8.png[/img]

7.  If you select Circle, change Gradient slider to 0 for composition.
8. VD replaces the colored vignette to passthrough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672198/58e42a55e1384a41563a21c493ad8aa881ac5b63.png[/img]

9. Adjust colors in VD and OVRLE for your comfort.
10. If you feel the edge is blurred, select high texture resolution in the OVRLE effect setting.

[h2]Patch note[/h2]

- Add custom color settings to Circle/Rect effect
- Add gradation slider to Circle effect
- Add HIGHEST (2048x2048) resolution to Circle/Rect effect setting
- Adjust Point effect default size

notes.title: [v1.4.0] Toggle effect by button combinations
notes.content:
You can now toggle effect visibility by any button combination you like.
Previously versions, it can be only toggled by the cross controller gesture but now any shortcuts are available.
[previewyoutube=seU3txfuxHY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Setup[/h2]
1. Click the [b]Setting[/b] menu on the tool dashboard.
2. Click the [b]CONTROLLER BINDINGS[/b] button then the SteamVR Input setting will open.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672198/6fc818fd26c6c07bae31132007af2946b82937b9.png[/img]

3. Set any buttons or button combinations (Chords) as [b]ToggleEffectEnable[/b] action.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672198/5f94be546d93a5ff4fbd5b67731833d7c573bd78.png[/img]

When you press the buttons or combinations that have [b]ToggleEffectEnabled[/b] action, all effects are toggled on/off by force.

You may use this with the "Always Display" effect to enable effect in specific situations like cut scenes that move the camera automatically.

[h2]Actions[/h2]
[list][*][b]LeftHandEffect[/b] : Display left hand effect.
[*][b]RightHandEffect[/b] : Display right hand effect.
[*][b]LeftHandEffectDigital[/b] : Display left hand effect. Same the above.
[*][b]RightHandEffectDigital[/b] : Display right hand effect. Same the above.
[*][b]ToggleEffectEnabled[/b] : Toggle effect visibility.[/list]

[h2]Guide[/h2]
The below SteamVR Input guide by OVR Advanced Settings is very detailed. Please check if you use SteamVR Input settings.
https://github.com/OpenVR-Advanced-Settings/OpenVR-AdvancedSettings/blob/master/docs/SteamVRInputGuide.md

If you have any questions, feel free to contact dev.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1393780/discussions/0/2943620809085398243/

tags.feature: You can now toggle effect visibility by any button combination you like.

notes.title: Update : Cross controller to enable/disable effect
notes.content:
v1.1.0 has been released!

[h1]New option : Cross controllers to enable effect[/h1]
Before version, cross controllers can only disable effect. v1.1.0 can reverse this setting, cross controllers to enable effect. If you toggle on this option, effects are disappeared until both controllers are crossed.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38672198/980d92ad4fb3653bf01fa8c97e59718d307b960b.png[/img]

This is for VR mods users that buttons are in short supply. If you have no problem about locomotion but get sick from cut scenes, try this option with the Always Display feature.

1. Adjust the left (or right) effect from the dashboard.
2. Toggle on Setting > Display Always.
3. Set Left (or Right) Hand slider to max value 1.00.
4. Toggle on Cross Controllers Gesture option.
5. Select "Enable Effect" as an action when crossing.

After the above settings, you can now display the vignette when you cross the controllers. Thanks for the request zeddyzed!

tags.feature: New option : Cross controllers to enable effect

notes.title: Full release - v1.0 is out now!
notes.content:
OVR Locomotion Effect v1.0 is out now!
If you want to be used to smooth locomotion or you stack games because of VR motion sickness, let's try the free demo. 

[h1]New UIs[/h1]

New UIs for setting screen that fit the SteamVR dashboard. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672198/d5d3bacbe60bf42e748effa1a9094e47d7d30e6e.png[/img]

[h1]Performance improvement[/h1]
The performance is greatly improved! Most of the processes have optimized to keep frame rate during game play as possible. This should helps to prevent frame rate drops than the early access version.

Though if you feel frame rate drops, try the following setting.
- Scale down the effect resolution.
- Hide a part of the room effect's ceil / walls / floor.
- Disable the effect of the hand not used.
- Scale down the HMD video resolution or adjust game graphics setting. 

[h2]Disable a part of the room effect[/h2]
You can now disable the ceil / walls / floor of the room effect to avoid frame rate drops. If the full room rendering is high-cost on your machine & game, you may only display the floor. By default the ceil drawing is disabled.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672198/f099145e8e0a7efe7403ebc3b7a5fa38cec9e35e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672198/b17c60a17ae8acad1d576b3f336cdbad86c4cdbd.png[/img]

[h1]New effects[/h1]

[h2]Point effect[/h2]
You can display dot / circle / cross on center of field of view likes first person shooting game. It can be shown always or during thumb-stick inputs.
(The video tried on the "Boneworks")
[previewyoutube=cycXC3Arxok;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Wind effect[/h2]
You can display a wind effect to the move direction you like. Select 2 directions (front-back / side) to 8 directions or free-direction.
[previewyoutube=MOPPAq0dmy8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
- Change the room effect overlay number 24 -> 6.
- Make the dashboard translucence during effect preview to check behind the dashboard. 
- Change effect reset button reset the selected effect only.
- Launch as Japanese at first launch if the user's system language is Japanese.
- Change effect animation more smoothly.
- Change the effect hide duration 5 sec to 2 sec.
- Change effect parameters to user's HMD (Quest 2 or others).
- Adjust effect default parameters.
- Open the SteamVR dashboard at launch automatically.
- Add a toggle option whether open the dashboard at launch automatically.
- Bug fixes.

[h1]Requests and bug reports[/h1]
Please post on the steam forum.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1393780/discussions/

Or post a discord server.
https://discord.gg/G4kkvfn

[h2]FAQ[/h2]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1393780/discussions/0/2943620809085398243/

Finally, thank you for join the beta test, early access, write reviews and other all supports! I hope this tool help gamers who stacks on the VR motion sickness like I was before.

- kurohuku

Now you can switch a beta brunch from Steam client properties. The beta brunch is the future update version. If you help beta tests, plese switch to beta brunch by following steps and send feedbacks to dev.

1. Right click "OVR Locomotion Effect" -> "Properties..." from the Steam Library.
2. Click "BETAS" tab.
3. Select the version "beta"
4. Then download is auto started.

[h2]Rollback to v0.3.2[/h2]
The default version of OVRLE has rollbacked to v0.3.1 that is not optimized CPU performance because v0.3.2 has an issue that crash just after launch on some environments.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1393780/discussions/0/2840039920185072651/

The v0.3.2 is moved to beta brunch avobe. If you have frame rate drop problem, please switch to beta brunch and use v0.3.2.

notes.title: Free Demo is Relased
notes.content:
Please try a free demo before purchase. Only difference to the product version is that the demo has time limit to each run. You can actually check the overlay with any VR game. Check whether it reduces motion sickness for you. The below is how to use the demo version.

[h2]How to use the demo?[/h2]
1. Launch the tool then click bottom icon on the SteamVR dashboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672198/f667bec8b1228ce443ae4d7ac1dae9d8aebe77d4.png[/img]

2. Click "Demo" from sidebar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672198/4691f8acc8ac6de0ff6dfacc93e1a0466dd02de5.png[/img]

3. Click "Start Demo" button then 60 sec timer starts.

4. Close the SteamVR dashboard and input thumbsticks then effects should be displayed. You can try all features on any VR game with an overlay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672198/fb7ae370c8d60e812be60083c76a04de13a6795f.png[/img]

5. After 60 sec, additional 15 sec cool time starts. When the cool time completed, you can push the button. You can try any number of times.

Notes: 60 sec time limit restricts displaying effects only that is displayed during the SteamVR dashboard has closed. You can change settings or check preview any time regardless the time limits. More details of this tool, please check below description.

[h2]v0.3.1 Update[/h2]
- Adjust slider width.
- Remove launch message.

notes.title: Early Access version is released
notes.content:
[b]"OVR Locomotion Effect" is out now. [/b] If you get motion sicness by thumbstick smooth locomotion in VR, it's time to try this overlay tool.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672198/146bdad50bef970083a7c7b3f727e1d888a43e13.png[/img]

Also it updated to v0.3 that involves below additionl options.

[list]
[*] Toggle "Show launch message in VR" on/off.
[*] Toggle "Quick disable by crossing controllers" on/off.
[*] Toggle "Keep effects horizontal" on/off.
[/list]

[h2]Keep Horizontal Settings[/h2]

If this option is set to on, overlays keep always horizontal to the real floor. The overlay's rotation is not changed by your head rotation. If it's off, overlays rotate accoding to your head.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672198/5b0d496c22ff96e24b49154e151c8ab706d809d6.png[/img]

Any feedbacks are welcome to improvement. If you find any ideas, bugs, or impressions, feel free to send the feedback to dev.
